text: {"memo": "Procter & Gamble (PG) delivered solid top‑line expansion in FY2024, with revenue rising to $84.04\u202fbillion from $82.01\u202fbillion in FY2023. Net income modestly improved to $14.88\u202fbillion versus $14.65\u202fbillion a year earlier, while operating income increased to $18.55\u202fbillion from $18.13\u202fbillion. Diluted EPS climbed to $6.02 per share from $5.90, reflecting continued earnings power. Operating cash flow accelerated sharply to $19.85\u202fbillion, up from $16.85\u202fbillion in FY2023, underscoring robust cash generation. The operating margin held steady at roughly 22\u202f% in both years, indicating disciplined cost management despite the revenue uptick. The modest double‑digit growth in EPS and the strong cash‑flow surge suggest healthy underlying demand and effective capital allocation. Overall, PG’s balanced growth and stable profitability support a favorable valuation outlook.\n\nView: PG remains a high‑quality consumer‑goods franchise with steady earnings and strong cash flow, warranting a buy rating."}
